decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program uses the firm's existing production and logistics know-how and its delivery results are easy to learn from, but after the 72-hour program was withdrawn it may be consolidated into the broader express line D.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular fire-door system and rests directly on the firm's in-house R&D and certification expertise.

The multi-model express line for doors and gates is the umbrella of the fast-delivery offering, and the firm can interpret and improve its results with existing manufacturing and logistics competence.
The fire and smoke protection door is a certified core product backed by in-house engineering, the kind of offer such firms keep long term.
